categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a full-stack, full-cycle IT infrastructure service and product provider. Its main business segments include IT operation and maintenance services, technical architecture consulting and integration, and intelligent operation and maintenance products and services. It serves large and medium-sized enterprises, institutions, and government departments across various industries such as finance, manufacturing, transportation, telecommunications, healthcare, energy, and education.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages multi-brand, cross-platform technology capabilities covering servers, storage, networks, operating systems, databases, and middleware. It provides full-cycle consulting from planning, architecture design, integration, commissioning to operation and maintenance. The company develops intelligent operation and maintenance products integrating AI technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, anomaly detection, and data analytics to enable automated, intelligent IT infrastructure management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large and medium-sized enterprises, institutions, and government entities primarily in the financial sector (including banks and other financial institutions), manufacturing, transportation, logistics, telecommunications, healthcare, energy, and education sectors. The financial industry accounts for the majority of revenue, with significant focus on banks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with revenue concentrated in North China, East China, South China, Southwest China, Central China, Northeast China, Northwest China, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and minimal overseas operations. The largest revenue contributions come from the North and East China regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT infrastructure supply chain, providing consulting, integration, operation, and maintenance services as well as intelligent operation and maintenance products. It acts as a third-party service provider and system integrator rather than a hardware manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding third-party operation and maintenance services, strengthening technical solutions and products, and achieving sustainable quality growth. R&D priorities include intelligent operation and maintenance platform upgrades, integration of AI and big data analytics, and enhancement of multi-architecture, modular, distributed, and high-performance intelligent operation products. The company invests in talent development, signal innovation, and digital transformation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of IT operation and maintenance services, technical architecture consulting and integration services, and intelligent operation and maintenance products. The company uses contract-based billing including fixed-term service contracts, work volume-based contracts, and product sales with acceptance-based revenue recognition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The IT infrastructure operation and maintenance market is highly fragmented with many competitors. The company holds a competitive position due to its comprehensive multi-brand technical capabilities, full-cycle consulting services, and proprietary intelligent operation products. It has established a strong brand reputation, especially in the financial sector, and maintains strategic partnerships with leading IT vendors to enhance its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.12 billion, a 20.22% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 86.8 million, down 40.64%. Despite revenue and profit declines due to market competition and reduced customer budgets, operating cash flow increased by 22.23%. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.93 billion and equity of RMB 1.53 billion, reflecting a stable financial scale with ongoing investments in R&D and infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering full-stack, full-cycle IT infrastructure services combined with intelligent operation and maintenance products powered by AI and big data analytics. Its multi-brand, cross-platform technical expertise and comprehensive consulting capabilities enable it to address complex, heterogeneous IT environments. The integration of best practices accumulated over nearly two decades into its proprietary intelligent operation platform provides customers with enhanced automation, predictive maintenance, and optimized resource management, ensuring secure, stable, and efficient IT infrastructure operations.
